name: Twitch gap tracking
ownerWords: fix plan and duties based on the board skill and pursue completion of plans
goal: The Twitch top 10 index gaps page on the wiki (domains/platform-apis/twitch-index-gaps) shows all 10 gaps with a number measured in the last day, the gap scripts in auto-sns-agent scripts/twitch-gaps measure every gap without a Twitch rate limit or a zero read, and no risk on the Twitch risks page (domains/platform-apis/twitch-risks) fires.

metrics.label: Gaps on the Twitch top 10 page with a number, when the page was measured in the last 24 h (0 when older)
Gaps the gap scripts failed to measure today, from a rate limit, a zero read, a crash or a missing script
Risks on the Twitch risks page that fire on today's run

onMiss: Work in /home/sieun/Documents/Github/auto-sns-agent under its AGENTS.md. The precheck already ran the gap scripts (`node scripts/twitch-gaps/run.mjs`) and kept their JSON as twitch-gaps.latest.json in this chat's duty folder (~/.prime/agent/browser-chat/duties/01a151ca-2bab-71ee-a334-bfae1773e0a0/); read the precheck's flagged items first. Every run, when that JSON's measuredAt is newer than the page's `<time data-measured>`, have one writer subagent refresh apps/llm-wiki/content/domains/platform-apis/twitch-index-gaps/index.html from it (c20), keeping the `<time data-measured datetime>`, `<tr data-gap>` and `data-size` markers, passing `node apps/llm-wiki/scripts/prose-lint.mjs` on the page, and committing it with node scripts/repo/agent/commit.mjs. When the JSON is missing or older than this run, rerun `node scripts/twitch-gaps/run.mjs --out <that file>` from the repo root first. failed_gaps: rerun each failed gap with `--only <key>` and, when it fails again, its fix job lands a fix in scripts/twitch-gaps. risks_firing: follow the 'what to do when it fires' line of each firing risk on apps/llm-wiki/content/domains/platform-apis/twitch-risks/index.html; a risk row with no check in sieun-pi components/user-history/scripts/duties/twitch-gaps.ts RISK_CHECKS gets its check added there. Each missed metric gets one fix step with duty "<this duty id>/<metric key>" and a live job; a step whose job is live gets the new numbers and flagged lines by message, and a step with no live job gets one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=...), never a second copy. Nothing goes outside (c37), and pushes and promotes need no ask (c74). All met and the page refreshed: end with no message.
